channel.title: Treease Changelog
channel.description: New updates and product improvements in Treease.

item.title: Faster, More Reliable Graphs and Better Product Feedback
item.description: Treease improves graph rendering performance and stability, adds an in-app feedback dialog, and strengthens product discoverability.

item.title: Smoother Accounts, Sharing, Billing, and Editor Navigation
item.description: Treease brings a more dependable account and sharing experience, clearer billing flows, improved editor navigation, and a smoother homepage demo.

item.title: Faster Stream Imports and a New Desktop Workspace Foundation
item.description: Streaming trace imports are faster, and Treease gains the foundation for a desktop workspace and release channel.

item.title: Clearer Structured Compare Diffs
item.description: Compare results now use explicit byte spans so differences are represented more accurately and remain easier to inspect.

item.title: More Stable Graph Rendering During Workspace Changes
item.description: Graph rendering and workspace resizing are now more dependable, with fewer readiness races and redundant controllers.

item.title: Standalone API Service
item.description: Treease now provides a standalone API service for integrations and programmatic access.

item.title: More Consistent Example Loading
item.description: Initial examples now follow the same complete editing and language-services flow as subsequent edits.

item.title: New Editor Presets, Tutorials, and Smoother Viewer Interactions
item.description: Treease adds reusable tutorial pages and URL-backed editor presets while improving graph navigation, import feedback, and CLI rendering.

item.title: Clearer CLI Version and Asset Download Feedback
item.description: The CLI now shows its version in help output and reports asset download progress.

item.title: More Reliable Runtime Readiness
item.description: Web runtime readiness is now more stable, reducing flaky behavior during graph loading and interaction.

item.title: Improved Subgraph Workspaces and Graph Editing
item.description: Subgraph editing is more coherent and reliable, while graph layout, edge convergence, minimap rendering, and CLI parsing receive important fixes.

item.title: More Predictable Parsing and Editor Highlighting
item.description: Treease fixes parsing regressions, clarifies null input behavior in the CLI, and preserves highlighting when switching language examples.

item.title: Better Nested JSON Expansion and Blank Input Handling
item.description: Nested JSON expansion is available again, blank text is processed consistently, and scalar output no longer adds an unwanted trailing newline.

item.title: NDJSON Import, Synchronized Viewing, and a More Capable CLI
item.description: Treease adds JSONL/NDJSON import support, improves editor-to-graph synchronization, and delivers a more agent-friendly CLI with a web graph route.

item.title: Treease Initial Release
item.description: Treease launches as a structured-text graph editor for exploring documents as synchronized text, tables, and graphs.
